title: Governed pre-inference plan and managed execution publication
intent: Rename the project-specific Decapod workspace runtime Dockerfile from .decapod/managed/Dockerfile to .decapod/managed/Dockerfile.decapod, preserving the root Dockerfile as the users application packaging boundary and updating every generator, executor, validator, allowlist, test, spec, and proof reference.

phases.name: Rename managed workspace Dockerfile
phases.description: Update the managed workspace Dockerfile contract and all code, scaffold, validation, tests, specs, and repository policy references while keeping the root Dockerfile reserved for application packaging.
